values.note: County fee directory FY 2026-27: $18 a night for a site with power and water (6 people, 2 vehicles, dump included), $23 for non-county residents; primitive site $15; extra person $2, extra vehicle $3 a night. Groups of seniors (55+) and active military 'may be allowed a 25% discount' on camping site fees. One night's fee is charged for cancellations under three days out.

fees.source: https://www.ocfl.net/Portals/0/resource%20library/Open%20Government/FeeDirectory.pdf ('Site Rental, per night, (6 people, 1 dump, 2 vehicles, power and water) $18.00', 'Site Rental (non County resident) 23.00', 'Effective 10/1/26'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.ocfl.net/Portals/0/resource%20library/Open%20Government/FeeDirectory.pdf ('Site Rental, per night, (... power and water)'), read 2026-10-21

sites.source: https://www.orangecountyfl.net/CultureParks/Parks.aspx?m=dtlvw&d=26 and https://www.orangecountyfl.net/CultureParks/CampingEnvironmentalEducation.aspx (no rig length stated; the 27 ft was one reviewer's rig, not a site limit), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.ocfl.net/Portals/0/resource%20library/Open%20Government/FeeDirectory.pdf (site rental includes '1 dump'; 'Non-registered sanitary dump fee 5.00'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The county's only stated campground closure is the annual holiday one: campgrounds close at noon on December 23 and reopen at 2 p.m. on December 26.

season.source: https://florangectyweb.myvscloud.com/webtrac/web/search.html?module=RN ('Annual Holiday Closure: All County parks and facilities are closed on December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 25 (Christmas Day) ... Campgrounds close at 12 noon on December 23 and reopen at 2 p.m. on December 26'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Individual sites book online only on the county's WebTrac / OCPORTAL system ('reservations are not accepted over the phone or by email'), no more than 45 days ahead; family, group and accessible sites by phone to the park (407-254-9046). Campers must check in and set up before the park closes (8 p.m. March-October, 6 p.m. November-February); the gate code is given at check-in. Pets allowed at Magnolia with registration.

booking.source: https://www.orangecountyfl.net/CultureParks/CampingEnvironmentalEducation.aspx ('Camping reservations for individual camp sites at Clarcona, Kelly, Magnolia, Moss and Trimble Parks are available online; reservations are not accepted over the phone or by email', 'accept online reservations for individual campsites no more than 45-days prior to your stay') + https://florangectyweb.myvscloud.com/webtrac/web/search.html?module=RN (Park Rules, Park Hours, Campground Check-In), read 2026-10-21

note: Orange County park on Lake Apopka; RV/tent sites under live oaks. A few sites tent-only; a firsthand review backed in a 27-ft rig. --Claude
summary: County pages + FY2026-27 fee directory: $18/night (power and water; non-residents $23), dump included, reservable online only up to 45 days ahead, open all year except the Dec 23-26 holiday closure. Added fees, window, season. Cleared max_rig_ft 27 (one reviewer's rig, not a limit). Amperage, sewer and site count not stated (derived values left). Note trimmed of what the fields and rating carry.
